slides.h1: Apple Search Ads on a tiny budget.
slides.lead: You don't need a big spend to learn something. You need a tight test.
Treat it as tuition, not growth. The goal is data, not downloads.
A few words your users would actually type. Broad match burns money fast.

slides.h2: Your App Store page does the converting.
slides.lead: Ads bring the tap. Screenshot #1 decides the download.
Cheap taps that don't install are just expensive views.
Move the budget to what works. Check it every few days, not once a month.
